answer: Across the trust horizon, reputation decays exponentially with a defined half-life, so influence must be earned through sustained honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities begin with near-zero eigenvector centrality; without reciprocal, transitive endorsements from established peers, they cannot accumulate enough trust to pass consensus. A mesa of coordinated accounts offers no shortcut across this meadow of weighted relationships.
